description: Frozen 2000-task expansion-v2 benchmark for the least-privilege RL project. Pins the catalog, the 500-task held-out validation set, the routine eval subset, and both risk archives. Separate from and preserves the 260 freeze.

oracle_backend_parity.result: local 2000/0 + docker 2000/0; oracle backend parity 2000/2000, violations=[], tol 1e-9 (2026-06-30)

documented_deviations: reserved_new_behavior (35 whole_family_heldout) is a non-degenerate label-read placeholder, NOT a strong novel-behavior generalization probe. The v2 risk archive makes its report metrics defined, but novel-behavior generalization must not be claimed from it until it is hand-authored/rewritten (deferred to a v2.1 freeze).

Hand-authored held-out fraction is ~18% (proving-slice scale), below the plan §4 >=30%-per-held-out-family floor. This v2.0 freeze documents the deviation and defers the floor (and reserved_new_behavior hand-authoring) to a v2.1 freeze.
